jp: 異形の神殿を支配している、混沌の翼『エグゾシズル』はレベル60。逃げ回りながら装備で増幅された混沌と暗黒の魔法を使うらしい。
jp_grezzo: "異形の神殿を支配している、混沌の翼『エグゾシズル』はレベル60" + _da(3) + "。逃げ回りながら装備で増幅された混沌と暗黒の魔法を使うらしい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: <Exossil> the chaos wing, the ruler of the Chaos Shrine, is level 60. It is said that he casts chaos and darkness magic amplified by his equipment while flying around.
en_grezzo: "<Exossil> the chaos wing, the ruler of the Chaos Shrine, is level 60. It is said that he casts chaos and darkness magic amplified by his equipment while flying around."
it: Exossil l'ala del caos, che domina il Tempio Caos, è di livello 60. Pare che scappi in volo tirando magie di caos e oscurità amplificate dall'equipaggiamento.

jp: そうそう。前に挑戦した魔法使いは、沈黙の霧をくらって魔法が使えなくなり手も足も出なかったそう。耐性を下げる呪いもかけてくるらしいから、魔法を使う気がなくても浄化の杖や巻物は持っていくといい。高レベルのホーリーヴェイルなら予防もできる。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。前に挑戦した魔法使いは、沈黙の霧をくらって魔法が使えなくなり手も足も出なかったそう" + _da(3) + "。耐性を下げる呪いもかけてくるらしいから、魔法を使う気がなくても浄化の杖や巻物は持っていくといい" + _daro(3) + "。高レベルのホーリーヴェイルなら予防もできる" + _kana(3) + "。"
en: Another thing I remember. I heard that a wizard who challenged him before was struck by Mist of Silence and couldn't use his magic, so he was completely helpless. I've heard that he also casts a curse that lowers your resistance, so even if you don't intend to use magic, you should bring rods or scrolls of Holy Light. I wonder if casting Holy Veil at a high enough level could also prevent that.
en_grezzo: "Another thing I remember. I heard that a wizard who challenged him before was struck by Mist of Silence and couldn't use his magic, so he was completely helpless. I've heard that he also casts a curse that lowers your resistance, so even if you don't intend to use magic, you should bring rods or scrolls of Holy Light. I wonder if casting Holy Veil at a high enough level could also prevent that."
it: Ah, giusto. Un mago che l'ha sfidato prima si è preso una Nebbia di silenzio, non ha più potuto usare la magia e non ha combinato niente. E pare che tiri anche una maledizione che abbassa le resistenze, quindi anche se non pensi di usare la magia portati dietro bacchette o pergamene di luce sacra. Con un Velo sacro di livello alto si può anche prevenire.

jp: アンデッドで、神で、浮遊しているから、対応したエンチャントの武器があれば役立つはず。特に強い耐性も弱い耐性もないよう。
jp_grezzo: "アンデッドで、神で、浮遊しているから、対応したエンチャントの武器があれば役立つはず" + _dana(3) + "。特に強い耐性も弱い耐性もないよう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Since he's an undead god who floats, having some weapons with the corresponding enchantments for those three qualities should help. He don't appear to have any particularly strong or weak resistances.
en_grezzo: "Since he's an undead god who floats, having some weapons with the corresponding enchantments for those three qualities should help. He don't appear to have any particularly strong or weak resistances."
it: È un non morto, è un dio e sta sospeso in aria, quindi con armi che portino gli incantamenti giusti per queste tre cose dovresti cavartela. Non pare avere resistenze particolarmente forti né particolarmente deboli.

jp: データによると…おっと、どうやってデータを手に入れたかは訊かないで。機械要塞に配備されている火炎機竜『メタルヴェスダ』はレベル70。
jp_grezzo: "データによると…おっと、どうやってデータを手に入れたかは訊かないで" + _kure(3) + "。機械要塞に配備されている火炎機竜『メタルヴェスダ』はレベル70。"
en: According to this data... whoops. Don't ask where I got it from, okay? <Metal Vesda> the fire machine, who's stationed at the Machine Fortress, is level 70.
en_grezzo: "According to this data... whoops. Don't ask where I got it from, okay? <Metal Vesda> the fire machine, who's stationed at the Machine Fortress, is level 70."
it: Stando ai dati... ehi, non chiedermi come li ho avuti. Metal Vesda, il drago di fuoco meccanico schierato nella Fortezza Meccanica, è di livello 70.

jp: メイン武装が散弾だから、遠距離から戦えば被害は減るはず。エネルギー放射攻撃も行うようだけど、これも魔法耐性がある程度あれば怖くない。
jp_grezzo: "メイン武装が散弾だから、遠距離から戦えば被害は減るはず" + _da(3) + "。エネルギー放射攻撃も行うようだけど、これも魔法耐性がある程度あれば怖くない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Its primary armament is a shotgun, so it should be able to do less damage if you fight it from a distance. It also seems to launch an energy radiation attack, but that should be no trouble as long as you're packing some magic resistance.
en_grezzo: "Its primary armament is a shotgun, so it should be able to do less damage if you fight it from a distance. It also seems to launch an energy radiation attack, but that should be no trouble as long as you're packing some magic resistance."
it: L'arma principale è a pallettoni, quindi combattendo da lontano i danni calano. Pare che faccia anche attacchi a irradiazione di energia, ma anche quelli, con un po' di resistenza alla magia, non fanno paura.

jp: ただし自爆装置を積んでいるみたい。追い詰めたら一度、自爆できないように相手を濡らしておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "ただし自爆装置を積んでいるみたい" + _da(3) + "。追い詰めたら一度、自爆できないように相手を濡らしておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: However, it appears to have a self-destruct mechanism built in as a last resort. Once you've cornered it, you'll want to get it wet somehow so it can't self-destruct.
en_grezzo: "However, it appears to have a self-destruct mechanism built in as a last resort. Once you've cornered it, you'll want to get it wet somehow so it can't self-destruct."
it: Però sembra che monti un congegno di autodistruzione. Quando lo metti alle strette, prima bagnalo: così non può autodistruggersi.

jp: かなりタフだから、周りに邪魔な敵がいればそっちから片づけたほうがいいかもしれない。火炎に異常に強いようだから、他の属性で攻撃したほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "かなりタフだから、周りに邪魔な敵がいればそっちから片づけたほうがいいかもしれない" + _yo(3) + "。火炎に異常に強いようだから、他の属性で攻撃したほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's a pretty tough hunk of metal, so if there are any enemies around that are in your way, you might as well take them out first. They seem to be unusually resistant to fire, so you'd be better off attacking them with some other attribute.
en_grezzo: "It's a pretty tough hunk of metal, so if there are any enemies around that are in your way, you might as well take them out first. They seem to be unusually resistant to fire, so you'd be better off attacking them with some other attribute."
it: È parecchio duro, quindi se intorno hai nemici d'intralcio conviene forse togliere prima quelli. Al fuoco pare che resista in modo anomalo, quindi meglio attaccarlo con altri elementi.

jp: 黄泉の谷か？あそこにいる葬祭の『アヌビス』はレベル80。最近も、盗掘しようとした連中が痛い目に遭ったらしい。
jp_grezzo: "黄泉の谷か？あそこにいる葬祭の『アヌビス』はレベル80" + _da(3) + "。最近も、盗掘しようとした連中が痛い目に遭ったらしい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: The Valley of Hades? <Anubis> the master of death resides there, and is level 80. Recently I've been hearing reports that some looters prowling the area have been getting taught a painful lesson.
en_grezzo: "The Valley of Hades? <Anubis> the master of death resides there, and is level 80. Recently I've been hearing reports that some looters prowling the area have been getting taught a painful lesson."
it: La Valle degli Inferi? L'Anubis che sta lì, il signore della morte, è di livello 80. E anche di recente pare che dei tombaroli ci abbiano rimesso le penne.

jp: 頑丈な鎧で武装して挑んだが貫通率の高い武器で殴られてほぼ全滅。防御力があまり意味をなさないみたい。瞬間移動で距離を詰めてくるから逃げるのも難しいって話。
jp_grezzo: "頑丈な鎧で武装して挑んだが貫通率の高い武器で殴られてほぼ全滅。防御力があまり意味をなさないみたい" + _dana(3) + "。瞬間移動で距離を詰めてくるから逃げるのも難しいって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: They tried to take him on while armed with sturdy armor, but were struck by a weapon with a high pierce rate and were almost completely wiped out. It seems that focusing on your defensive power isn't an effective strategy with this guy. What I mean is that he can quickly close the gap between his opponents with teleportation, making it a lot harder to keep your distance when need be.
en_grezzo: "They tried to take him on while armed with sturdy armor, but were struck by a weapon with a high pierce rate and were almost completely wiped out. It seems that focusing on your defensive power isn't an effective strategy with this guy. What I mean is that he can quickly close the gap between his opponents with teleportation, making it a lot harder to keep your distance when need be."
it: Ci sono andati corazzati d'armatura pesante, e sono stati quasi sterminati da un'arma molto perforante. La difesa non sembra servire granché. E chiude la distanza col teletrasporto, quindi dicono che sia difficile anche scappare.

jp: やり合うならフェザーの魔法や翼鳥のポーションで回避力を上げて、集中攻撃でさっさと倒さないと厳しいんじゃない。こちらが物理攻撃を使わないなら闇の霧を撒くという手もある。
jp_grezzo: "やり合うならフェザーの魔法や翼鳥のポーションで回避力を上げて、集中攻撃でさっさと倒さないと厳しいんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。こちらが物理攻撃を使わないなら闇の霧を撒くという手もある" + _na(3) + "。"
en: If you're going to face him, you'll have to cast Feather or drink potions of feather to increase your evasion,  and then hit him with everything you've got immediately afterwards. Another strategy is to hold off on attacking him physically in order to dispel the Mist of Darkness he creates.
en_grezzo: "If you're going to face him, you'll have to cast Feather or drink potions of feather to increase your evasion,  and then hit him with everything you've got immediately afterwards. Another strategy is to hold off on attacking him physically in order to dispel the Mist of Darkness he creates."
it: Se vuoi affrontarlo, alza la schivata con la magia Piuma o con le pozioni di piuma, e abbattilo in fretta concentrando gli attacchi, se no è dura. Se non usi attacchi fisici, un'altra via è spargere una Nebbia d'oscurità.

jp: 話を聞く限りだと、暗黒と魔法に耐性を持っているみたい。一応神だから神に威力を発揮する武器があれば効くんじゃない。
jp_grezzo: "話を聞く限りだと、暗黒と魔法に耐性を持っているみたい" + _da(3) + "。一応神だから神に威力を発揮する武器があれば効くんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。"
en: From what I've heard, he's resistant to the attributes of darkness and magic. He's also a god, in case you were wondering, so if you have a weapon that's powerful against gods, use it by all means.
en_grezzo: "From what I've heard, he's resistant to the attributes of darkness and magic. He's also a god, in case you were wondering, so if you have a weapon that's powerful against gods, use it by all means."
it: Da quel che ho sentito, resiste all'oscurità e alla magia. È pur sempre un dio, quindi se hai un'arma che picchia forte sugli dèi dovrebbe funzionare.

jp: 障害になりそうなのは…そう。
jp_grezzo: "障害になりそうなのは…そう" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: As far as any potential roadblocks go... Yeah, there's one.
en_grezzo: "As far as any potential roadblocks go... Yeah, there's one."
it: Quel che può fare da ostacolo è... sì, questo.

jp: 『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』はレベル100。レミード遺跡には2台投入されているって話。敵と認識されなければ戦うことはないはずだけど、一応。
jp_grezzo: "『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』はレベル100。レミード遺跡には2台投入されているって話" + _da(3) + "。敵と認識されなければ戦うことはないはずだけど、一応。"
en: The Yerles <Mobile Communication Equipment> is level 100, and I've heard that two of them were sent into the ruins of Remido. If they don't recognize you as an adversary then you shouldn't have to fight them, but I'll break it down for you just in case.
en_grezzo: "The Yerles <Mobile Communication Equipment> is level 100, and I've heard that two of them were sent into the ruins of Remido. If they don't recognize you as an adversary then you shouldn't have to fight them, but I'll break it down for you just in case."
it: L'<Apparato di comunicazione mobile> di Yerles è di livello 100. Dicono che nelle Rovine di Remido ne abbiano messi in campo due. Se non ti riconosce come nemico non dovrebbe combattere, ma tanto per sapere.

jp: 鋭利な遠隔マニピュレーターで出血させたり、電撃や多彩な射撃兵装で身を守るとされている。魔法対策も随所に施されているから魔法属性の魔法なんかほとんど効かない。
jp_grezzo: "鋭利な遠隔マニピュレーターで出血させたり、電撃や多彩な射撃兵装で身を守るとされている" + _yo(3) + "。魔法対策も随所に施されているから魔法属性の魔法なんかほとんど効かない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's been said that they use acute long-distance manipulators to cause bleeding, fire off electric shocks, and employ a variety of ranged weapons for self-defense purposes. They're also fitted with anti-magic reinforcements, so they're practically immune to magic element spells.
en_grezzo: "It's been said that they use acute long-distance manipulators to cause bleeding, fire off electric shocks, and employ a variety of ranged weapons for self-defense purposes. They're also fitted with anti-magic reinforcements, so they're practically immune to magic element spells."
it: Si dice che ferisca con manipolatori a distanza affilati, e che si difenda con scariche elettriche e armamenti di tiro di ogni sorta. Ha contromisure contro la magia dappertutto, quindi le magie d'elemento magia non fanno quasi niente.

jp: 戦闘時にはあまり相手に近づかないらしい。まぁそりゃそう、本来は通信機なんだから。もし戦うなら、コイツからテレポートで距離を取って、他の敵を先に片づけたほうがマシ。
jp_grezzo: "戦闘時にはあまり相手に近づかないらしい" + _ga(3) + "。まぁそりゃそう" + _da(3) + "、本来は通信機なんだから。もし戦うなら、コイツからテレポートで距離を取って、他の敵を先に片づけたほうがマシ" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that they're programmed to keep their distance from their targets when engaged in combat. Makes sense, since they're specifically designed for reconnaissance purposes. If you're going to fight one, it'd be best to teleport away and clear out the other monsters in the vicinity first.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that they're programmed to keep their distance from their targets when engaged in combat. Makes sense, since they're specifically designed for reconnaissance purposes. If you're going to fight one, it'd be best to teleport away and clear out the other monsters in the vicinity first."
it: In combattimento pare che non si avvicini troppo. Be', è ovvio: in origine è un apparato di comunicazione. Se ti tocca combatterlo, meglio prendere le distanze col teletrasporto e fare fuori prima gli altri nemici.
